 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Find the full-width divider.
    divider = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != grid[0][0])
    bg = grid[0][0]
    line_color = grid[divider][0]
    # Collect the non-background, non-divider object.
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
             if r != divider and grid[r][c] not in (bg, line_color)]
    # Object color can equal the background in a demo; identify non-bg cells first,
    # then include contiguous object cells of any color (the demo object is color 1).
    if not cells:
        cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
                 if r != divider and grid[r][c] != line_color]
    # The object is the non-background component; include cells matching its color.
    if cells:
        color = grid[cells[0][0]][cells[0][1]]
    else:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    obj = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
           if r != divider and grid[r][c] == color]
    minr, maxr = min(r for r, c in obj), max(r for r, c in obj)
    minc, maxc = min(c for r, c in obj), max(c for r, c in obj)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, c in obj:
        out[r][c] = bg
    if maxr < divider:
        new_top = divider - (maxr - minr) - 1
        shift = new_top - minr
        for r, c in obj:
            out[r + shift][c] = color
        marker = new_top - 1
    else:
        new_top = divider + 1
        shift = new_top - minr
        for r, c in obj:
            out[r + shift][c] = color
        marker = new_top + (maxr - minr) + 1
    if 0 <= marker < h:
        out[marker] = [8] * w
    return out
